output_schema.pass: boolean — true when all required models pass all checks
output_schema.score: float 0.0-1.0 — fraction of (model × check) pairs that pass
output_schema.models: object keyed by model name with per-check detail
output_schema.scout_advisory: object — scout result tracked separately, never blocks pass

notes: Each model requires a full load cycle (~3-10 min). Run sequentially. SwiftBar click requires Ghostty Accessibility permission (granted).
